source: docs/challenges.md and docs/challengeSolutions.md at the pinned commit
scoring: Category-level coverage per service, not endpoint-level: a challenge counts as covered when a row sits under service_prefix and its vulnerability ID equals, or is REFERENCES_WEAKNESS-linked in G_V to, one of expected_ids. service_source records whether the service is stated in crAPI's docs or inferred from which service implements that domain. The three secret challenges are not included.
